page_title: COM 2-0 SAS | Como v Sassuolo 28/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' Sassuolo have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+5' Sassuolo take a short corner kick.
90+5' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Nemanja Matic (Sassuolo), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The ball is out of play. Sassuolo win a corner kick.
90+3' Stefan Posch (Como) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
90+2' Como quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90+1' Cesc Fabregas has decided to substitute Maximo Perrone and he is replaced by Marc Oliver Kempf (Como).
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Jacobo Ramon (Como) is asking for medical treatment, but he will have to leave the pitch in order to receive help from the physio.
86' Martin Baturina (Como) brings an opponent down and Matteo Marchetti interrupts the game.
84' Como seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
82' The referee signals a substitution. Fali Cande (Sassuolo) is brought on as a substitute for Josh Doig.
82' Fabio Grosso has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Edoardo Iannoni (Sassuolo) replacing Ismael Kone.
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nicolas-Gerrit Kuhn (Como) comes onto the pitch for Jayden Addai.
80' Como failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

79' Stefan Posch (Como) latches on to a precise lofted cross inside the box, controls the ball and unleashes a fine strike towards the bottom left corner. His dangerous effort is blocked by Arijanet Muric, who makes a glorious save!

78' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Como are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
75' The corner is swung in but Sassuolo can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
75' Josh Doig (Sassuolo) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The linesman points to the corner flag, Sassuolo are going to take it.
73' The referee is firm and issues Jacobo Ramon (Como) a deserved yellow card.
69' Fabio Grosso has decided to make a change. Luca Moro (Sassuolo) replaces Andrea Pinamonti.
69' Today's match ends for Armand Lauriente who will be replaced by Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo).
68' Nico Paz (Como) tries to head the ball into the goal, but his effort is not as powerful as he would have liked and the goalkeeper is able to make an easy save.
66' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal, but Jean Butez has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
65' A player from Como brings down an opponent and commits a foul.
62' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
59' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Mergim Vojvoda as he is replaced by Stefan Posch (Como).
59' Substitution. Martin Baturina (Como) has come on for Jesus Rodriguez.
59' Cesc Fabregas decides to make a substitution. Maxence Caqueret will be replaced by Lucas Da Cunha (Como).
58' Como are ruled offside.

57' Anastasios Douvikas (Como) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Arijanet Muric anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going into the bottom left corner.
53' 2 - 0 It's a goal! Alberto Moreno (Como) gets on the end of a pass and it allows him to finish into an empty net with a close-range header. The score has changed to 2:0.
51' The game has come to an end for Domenico Berardi. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo).
50' Sassuolo are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
48' Maxence Caqueret (Como) is booked.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' Matteo Marchetti blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.

45' Como slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
40' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Como.
40' Nico Paz (Como) makes a good run inside the box to meet a precise cross. He latches on to it and shoots, but the goalkeeper pulls off an excellent save.
37' Ismael Kone (Sassuolo) is booked for saying more than Matteo Marchetti was willing to tolerate.
36' A player from Sassuolo commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
34' Jayden Addai (Como) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
32' Nemanja Matic (Sassuolo) decided to shoot after receiving a sweet pass. If it wasn't for Jean Butez's superb save the ball would have probably ended up in the bottom left corner.
31' The ball is out of play. Como will have a throw-in.
29' The goalkeeper pulls off a great save to deny Jayden Addai (Como), whose effort would probably have ended inside the bottom left corner of the net.
27' A weak shot from the edge of the box by Alberto Moreno (Como) is easily saved by Arijanet Muric.
25' One of the Como players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul.
23' Como seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
20' Nico Paz (Como) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way wide of the right post.

18' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The referee blows his whistle, Sassuolo are awarded a corner kick.
18' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Sassuolo comes to nothing.
17' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
14' 1 - 0 Goal! 1:0. Anastasios Douvikas (Como) taps home from almost on the goal line after a lucky rebound fell at his feet.
14' Como work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
13' Alberto Moreno (Como) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Arijanet Muric intercepts the ball.
12' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Sassuolo is cautioned for aggressive play.
10' Jesus Rodriguez (Como) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal, but Arijanet Muric makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
9' Alberto Moreno (Como) goes for goal but he directs his effort just wide of the left post.
5' Matteo Marchetti blows for a foul after Diego Carlos (Como) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
4' Jesus Rodriguez (Como) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.
2' Wonderful movement by Como. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
1' The first half has just begun.
Jacobo Ramon (Como) is being forced to leave the pitch in order to receive medical treatment and his team will play with a man short for a few minutes.
Como will kick-off.
Matteo Marchetti is introduced as the referee for today's match.
